properties.name: The unexported-work nudge is answered once, for the seat
properties.rationale:
⭐ THE REPORTED SYMPTOM WAS NOISE AND THE MEASURED DEFECT WAS FALSEHOOD, and the difference chose the fix. The report described five noisy lines burying one true one; the committed record was `in_step` at 3662/3662 and emitted nothing, so there was no true line and every one of the five was untrue. A noise framing leads to ranking, deduplication or path filtering — all of which would have left five false sentences saying the same false thing more quietly.

🛑 AND THE FIX THE SYMPTOM ARGUES FOR IS ALREADY ON THE RECORD AS WRONG. Every noisy path sat under /tmp, so 'forget scratch targets' is the obvious move and was the one proposed. `chg:the-orientation-call-stops-rereading-stale-records` shipped exactly that rule five weeks ago and reverted it — fifteen tests in `the_record_moved_and_the_session_is_told` failed and were right to, because hermetic tests, CI workspaces and containers all put genuine shared records under a temp dir. It would also not have worked: this seat tracks a 1545-node backup outside any temp path that produces the identical false sentence on entering the freshest six. Step ② of the root-cause skill paid for itself here — the precedent search returned the refutation of the leading candidate before any code was touched.

⭐ THE CLASS, WHICH IS WHAT MAKES THIS MORE THAN A LINE-COUNT FIX: a per-item computation phrased as a whole-system fact, invisible because every test used exactly ONE item. All 21 tests in this file drove a single sync target, at which scope the per-file answer and the seat answer are identical and the bug cannot appear. The served surface routinely carries six. The pinning tests now drive TWO targets — one current beside one stale — which is the smallest fixture in which the two scopes can disagree.

OBSERVED FAILING FIRST: `a_stale_side_record_does_not_claim_the_seat_holds_unexported_work` was written against the unfixed code and panicked with the false sentence quoted in the assertion output, then passed after the change. 23 tests pass in the file; fmt and clippy clean.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: `loop_status` no longer emits one 'N node(s) have never been exported' line per stale record. `sync_debt::unexported_work(&debts, live_nodes)` answers the question ONCE for the seat: it takes the most complete record the seat is accounted for against (states `in_step` or `moved_but_current` only — a `behind` record's count is inflated by another seat's work and cannot vouch for this one's), stays silent if that record already holds as much as the graph does however far every other record has fallen, and otherwise returns a single line naming that record and the number of nodes in NO record. The clause was REMOVED from `SyncDebt::message()`, whose in-step arm now always returns the node-count-bounds sentence — a message about one file may describe that file and may not speak for the graph. ON REFLOW2'S OWN SEAT this turns 5 false lines into 0.
